info.title: API.SH: eFinancialCareers
info.description: The eFinancialCareers API from API.SH: public eFinancialCareers data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
eFinancialCareers news and career-advice articles, newest or most viewed first, optionally one category: title, teaser, category, published time, views, comments, likes, sponsored flag, image and link, with the total.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/efinancialcareers-articles

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category (financial-services, technology, advice, ...).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order (default latest).

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Edition (default us).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Articles a page (1-50, default 20).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One job ad on eFinancialCareers: title, company and brand ids, location with coordinates, salary, position and employment type, sectors, reference, posting dates, the employer's own apply link and the full description. Give `id` or `url`, or `q` (plus any search filter) to open the first matching current ad.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/efinancialcareers-job

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Job id (the number after .id in the URL).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Job URL on any eFinancialCareers site.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (title, skill or company).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City or place; the site geocodes it (e.g. London, New York, Singapore).

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Distance around location.

parameters.name: radius_unit
parameters.description: Unit for radius.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code used to resolve location.

parameters.name: include_remote
parameters.description: 1 = also include remote jobs.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency for salary bands (three letters, e.g. GBP, USD).

parameters.name: work_arrangement
parameters.description: HYBRID, IN_OFFICE, REMOTE, FLEXIBLE or TEMPORARILY_REMOTE.

parameters.name: salary_band
parameters.description: FIRST_TIER (up to 40k), SECOND_TIER (40-80k), THIRD_TIER (80-150k), FOURTH_TIER (150-250k), FIFTH_TIER (250-500k), SIXTH_TIER (500k+).

parameters.name: posted
parameters.description: ONE (today), THREE (3 days) or SEVEN (7 days).

parameters.name: position_type
parameters.description: PERMANENT, CONTRACT, TEMPORARY, INTERNSHIPS_AND_GRADUATE_TRAINEE or SELF_EMPLOYED.

parameters.name: employment_type
parameters.description: FULL_TIME or PART_TIME.

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Sector value from facets (e.g. INFORMATION_TECHNOLOGY, ASSET_MANAGEMENT, RISK_MANAGEMENT).

parameters.name: seniority
parameters.description: INTERN_GRADUATE, JUNIOR, ANALYST, ASSOCIATE_MID_LEVEL, AVP_SENIOR, VP_PRINCIPAL, SVP_HEAD_OF, DIRECTOR and more (see facets).

parameters.name: experience
parameters.description: NO_EXPERIENCE, ONE_THREE_YEARS_EXPERIENCE, THREE_FIVE_YEARS_EXPERIENCE, … (see facets).

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Only this company's jobs (company id from facets or job results).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 20).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Finance, banking, fintech and financial-technology jobs on eFinancialCareers, worldwide, for keywords and a place, with every filter the site offers: work arrangement, salary band, posting date, position and employment type, sector, seniority, experience, company and remote. Each result has the title, company, location, salary text and range, position type, sectors, summary and dates. `facets` gives the counts for every filter and `top_companies` the busiest employers. 20 per page (up to 100 with limit).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/efinancialcareers-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
